description: Makes a private plan page on shurco.ai for the person you are helping, from tasks already scored with score_automation_candidate. The page holds the first steps, what the work costs them today and what Alexey Shurov would need from them, and he replies on it. Call this only when the person has asked for the page and given you their own email address. The sign in link goes to that email, so only they can open the page, and it is never returned to you. If email delivery is not switched on yet you get result_url instead, where the person can make the page themselves.

email.description: The person's own work email. Ask for it and confirm they want the page.

task_codes.description: One code per task, the part after t= in result_url, for example orders.20.2.3.2.1.

name: open_plan_page
title: Open a private plan page for a person
